text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: We're here♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Woohoo! It's the absolute best day for the 
hot springs! That's Happy 100 Miles for 
sure~!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Looks like our travel plans are coming 
along nicely! Please enjoy yourself to the 
fullest today!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, today was the day for the hot 
springs trip won from the raffle!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As promised, Gran Alegria planned out a 
full schedule for today.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
It'd be a waste of time to hang around, so 
let's get going already!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
First is right here! The Umamusume 
Museum~!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, nice reaction! I hear it's a museum 
dedicated mostly to Umamusume from this 
region!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
A mini-theater of legendary races, or... 
Ah, it looks like there's a stamp rally, 
too!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Next up is lunch! Their signature dish was 
something you'd really like, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look, look, this is it! Though I 
thought you might like this one too—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: And... here's the shrine! Ehehe~

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I heard this shrine is famous for 
matchmaking and connections! See, forming 
good bonds is super important for a 
Trainer too, right?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And so, our entirely 'Trainer-first' 
hot springs trip came to an end in the 
blink of an eye—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After getting out of the bath, I waited 
for her to return while reflecting on 
everything that happened today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking back, it was so entirely for my 
sake that I almost feel guilty—

text_block_list.name: Traveling Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Hey, have you been to that cat cafe over 
there? Apparently, you get 30 times the 
miles this month~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I come to my senses at the familiar word. 
Gran Alegria loves miles. I feel like... 
she even collects shopping miles, too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Would someone who researched things so 
thoroughly really overlook information 
like a 30x mile bonus?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Thanks for waiting, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, what's wrong? You look like 
you're lost ten miles in confusion!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, I already knew that! 30x miles!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course, it's quite a simple 
story!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
30x miles was super tempting! And I mean, 
there were tons of other offers, too.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
A store where you can rack up tons of 
miles... Part of me kinda wants to check 
it out, you know?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: But still, but still, more importantly—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Making you happy, Trainer, was just far 
more appealing to me this time.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Personally, this is a 50-mile level 
of surprise to me, you know!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
—It's getting a bit warm in here, so why 
don't we talk while taking a walk outside?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Haaah, so cool and refreshing!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"...We've been together for so long that I 
feel like you ought to know already, 
though!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Up until now, I've pretty much... always 
prioritized what I really wanted to do 
first and foremost!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Races, being the Mile Queen, and my own 
rules! Every single one is deeply precious 
to me!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"That's how I was raised, and thinking 
this way has made me so much stronger."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Still!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Still, it was different back then. When we 
were planning our hot springs trip—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I just really wanted to make you happy, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
So I held back on the 30x Miles this time♪ 
I made it a trip purely for them to have 
tons of fun.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Aha! Looks pretty complicated~!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
It's fine, it all circles back to what I 
want to do anyway.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Besides......—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
The thought that I wanted to make you 
happy more than myself... somehow made me 
really glad!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Because isn't it pure happiness? 
Especially when that person is your very 
own Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: "I'm so very happy, like 100-mile happy!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
They were three happy years, which is why 
it's a "Happy 100 Miles"!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I've got plenty of plans lined up 
for tomorrow, too!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Happy 100 Miles to you too, Trainer! 
Please enjoy yourself with your biggest 
smile!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Our promise—no!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Let's make that Trainer-san's house rule 
for tomorrow, okay?♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond between Gran Alegria 
and myself...
